complexity_review: Retrograde outcome propagation with remaining legal degrees; terminal winners seed predecessor win/loss resolution; unknown closed remainder draws. O(n*(n+E)) time, O(n^2) auxiliary space.
evidence_scope: prospective finite public-domain output/type/local-effects qualification, not universal proof
objective: Undirected graph game starts mouse at 1, cat at 2, mouse first. Mouse wins at 0; cat wins on capture. Cat cannot enter 0. Repeating the same positions and turn draws. Return 1,2,0 respectively under optimal play.
official_domain: 3<=vertices<=50; unique loop-free neighbor lists, each nonempty and shorter than vertex count; symmetric edges; legal movement always exists, for every reachable nonterminal turn (not every graph vertex).
provenance: Owner-provided existing implementations, independently reviewed against official public statement; original files unchanged.
